finalists.why: It has broad for evidence including fever, neutropenia, and gram-variable rods in the necrotic epidermis and dermis.

finalists.label: Nocardiosis
finalists.why: It has specific for evidence including Hematoxylin-eosin stain and Gram stain results showing filamentous bacilli with septa and gram-variable rods, which are characteristic of Nocardia species.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because its for evidence, including the specific findings of filamentous bacilli with septa and gram-variable rods, is highly specific and decisive, outweighing the broader but less specific evidence for the runner-up.
